slide_title: Using FF NN for Multiplication of Multiple Vectors by Multiple Matrices
subtitle_or_header: Usage: Multiply Vectors of All Words by Multiple (different) Wₖ (Keys of Multiple Heads)

labels: X₁ X₂ X₃ X₄ (circle labels, repeated on each of the 5 embedding rows)
y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ (circle labels, repeated on each of the 15 projection rows)
= (single large red equals sign between the matrix block and the projections block)
equations: = (the only printed mathematical symbol; it asserts: Output Projections = Embeddings × Wₖ, computed once per head)
[implied, not printed] For each head h and each word i (i = 1..5): row [y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄] of Word #i = Xᵢ (1×4 embedding) · Wₖ of Head h (4×4 matrix)

layout.arrangement: Title centered at top with a circled slide number at top-right; two-tone subtitle centered beneath it. A large light rounded panel in the upper-middle holds five labeled embedding-vector rows stacked on the left and three 4x4 weight matrices (Head 1, Head 2, Head 3) side by side to their right, each with a header above. Below and slightly left sits a large red equals sign. A second rounded panel in the lower-middle holds three column groups of five 4-circle projection rows aligned under each matrix, with captions beneath each group. Five red annotation lines are stacked at the far right edge, one per projection row. A blue-outlined bullet box sits at the bottom-left.

layout.hierarchy: Red bold title is the largest text; subtitle is second (bold, blue+red, smaller); matrix headers and left embedding labels are small bold red/blue; circle and cell glyphs are smallest. Visually the three pastel matrices and the ~40 red-ringed circles dominate the canvas; the light panels let the colored cells/pills carry the visual weight.

visual_elements.description: Five horizontal embedding rows, one per word. Each row: a red bold two-line label ('Embedding Vector' / 'of Word #N', N = 1..5) followed by a larger italic red vector name X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄, X₅ (numeric subscript); to the right a pill-shaped rounded rectangle (light pink fill, pink-red outline) containing 4 equally spaced circles — white fill, red ~1.5pt outline — labeled X₁ X₂ X₃ X₄ (italic X, dark text, numeric subscripts). All five rows are identical except the label number.
visual_elements.position: left side of upper panel, ~6-30% width, ~23-58% height

visual_elements.description: Three 4x4 weight matrices, one per head, each drawn as 16 small squares with thin dark borders inside a rounded-rectangle container. Header above each: italic bold 'Wₖ' (dark blue) + ' of Head N' (red). Cell entries are identical across all three matrices — row 1: w₁₁ w₂₁ w₃₁ w₄₁; row 2: w₁₂ w₂₂ w₃₂ w₄₂; row 3: w₁₃ w₂₃ w₃₃ w₄₃; row 4: w₁₄ w₂₄ w₃₄ w₄₄ (italic lowercase w, dark navy text, two-digit subscripts). Row fill colors (same in all three matrices): row 1 yellow, row 2 pink, row 3 orange, row 4 green. Container tints: Head 1 light green, Head 2 light orange, Head 3 light purple.
visual_elements.position: center-right of upper panel; three columns at ~31-48%, ~49-66%, ~67-84% width; headers ~22-26% height, grids ~26-58% height

visual_elements.description: Three column groups of output projections, aligned under the three matrices. Each group = five stacked pill-shaped rounded rectangles, each holding 4 white circles with red outlines labeled y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ (italic y, dark red/maroon text, numeric subscripts). Pill fills top-to-bottom cycle: green, orange, purple, green, orange (same cycle in all three groups). Caption centered under each group: 'Corresponding Projections at Head 1' / '...Head 2' / '...Head 3' (red bold; the words 'at Head N' appear possibly blue [?]).
visual_elements.position: bottom panel; three columns at ~30-48%, ~48-66%, ~66-84% width; rows ~61-89% height, captions ~89-94% height

imagery: No photographs, clip-art, or illustrations; the slide is built entirely from vector shapes (circles, pills/rounded rectangles, small squares) and text.

Small gray rectangle artifact (likely the captured mouse cursor or a selection handle) overlaps Head 1's matrix around row 3, near cells w₂₃/w₃₃ — a recording artifact, not slide content; do not recreate.

typography_notes: Entirely bold sans-serif (Arial/Calibri family). Title largest (~28-32pt equivalent), bold, red. Subtitle ~16-18pt bold, two-tone blue/red with italic 'Wₖ'. Panel labels ~10-12pt bold; variable letters (X, W, w, y) are italic with numeric subscripts; matrix/circle glyphs ~10-12pt. Summary-box text ~12-14pt bold with round bullets. No all-caps except the acronym 'FF NN'. Color-coding convention: red for primary/emphasized text, blue for secondary/connector phrases.
